schemaFamilies.note: V2 purpose-bound runtime_use approval is distinct from fleet_management. Existing v1 registration does not persist purpose or an authenticated actor. Bind in MCOMP-07/MCOMP-13; no schema grants authority.
Projection shape exists; endpoint delivery and authenticated mutation-time policy/catalog binding remain pending (DESKTOP-LOCAL/1).

V2 publishes workflow_claim/renew/settle/release and opaque ownerEpoch. Existing WorkflowOwnerPort has claim only and numeric epochs. MCOMP-17 must implement lifecycle and preserve delegation; never coerce or strip.
V1 transport remains selected. V2 /v2/invoke requires explicit availability negotiation; importing schemas enables nothing.

No prepare/consume/settle/reconcile wire operation. MCOMP-13-01 uses the local version-1 EndpointPort.preparedExecution seam to forward exact AdmissionRequest and authenticated identity/connection generation, retaining the producer lease. The real client supplies no such port: admission is unavailable and never invokes execution to obtain a permit. Wire mapping remains pending (PREPARED/1).
No request/decision schema for ManagedEffect plus ManagedEffectBinding. Existing unavailableEffectAuthority refuses every effect; EFFECT/1 is only a proposal.
V2 grant UUID/digest chains differ from local principal chains/grantRef. Resolve authenticated custody and preserve root/parent lineage in MCOMP-17; legacy host refuses nonempty delegation.
Signed command correlation exists; v1 cancel/refresh/status cannot carry v2 pause/resume acquisition and settlement. MCOMP-29 binds existing commands.ts journal; no operator_prompt authority.
Reuse endpointInboxPort and private receipt journal. Device recovery schemas exist but no local receipt-recovery operation (RECOVERY-LOCAL/1); notices retain agentInput:false.
Reuse usage.ts, event-journal.ts and telemetry spool; MCOMP-27 binds real observations and durable receipts without inventing metering.
Signed content roles and central HTTP upload schemas exist. Local contentDeliveryStanding remains unavailable; bounded local capture/upload/status transport is missing (CONTENT-LOCAL/1).
MCOMP-27 maps lifecycle and content provenance via existing metadata/event spool; central TRACE/governance derivation is not a new desktop authority.
Reuse signed policy and rollback/freshness checks; local approved offline-choice projection operation missing (DESKTOP-LOCAL/1). No schema proves current time or signatures.
Existing endpoint operations plus finance offlineAllowance and routing modelRoute schemas; prepared consumer must bind reservation, price revision, exact route and credential references (PREPARED/1).

Reuse credentials.ts and browser/shell/plugin/install/local-effects policy ports. Published general constraints do not define their authenticated local ceiling delivery (DESKTOP-LOCAL/1); no permissive defaults.

Route receipts bind binary/version/transport/OS/backend; parsing is not verification. Native authenticated peer transport and prepared confinement still need actual platform/provider proofs (PREPARED/1).

MCOMP-09-05 composes the existing v1 enrollment/registration/attachment transport with protected custody ports, live standing, refresh/reconnect and terminal shutdown. startRuntimeHost composes by default and carries one composition through its lifetime. Plain Node has no protected seal and remains held; v2 runtime_use registration remains pending under REGISTRATION-HTTP/2. Fixture registration is not actor or native qualification.

remainingWork.scope: Internal Maestro behavior proceeds through existing typed ports in the named implementation tasks. All new external mappings stay pending/unqualified until published definitions and paired verification agree; proposal operation names are never sent.
remainingWork.executionAuthority: MCOMP-13-01 removed broker-receipt-to-local-lease conversion. MCOMP-13-02 implements a local per-effect consumer with no production producer; PREPARED/1 and EFFECT/1 wire mappings remain pending.

extensionProposals.version: purpose-bound runtime approval HTTP mapping for registration schema 2
extensionProposals.operations: Existing approve_runtime_registration HTTP body remains v1. Propose a negotiated v2 mapping; no new route is sent.
extensionProposals.missing: Public runtimeApprovalInputV2 exists, but http-operations accepts only challengeId/nonce/challengeDigest. No public session identifier is exposed for consumer-side session correlation; session binding remains server-owned. Never drop purpose/version to fit v1.

extensionProposals.version: new versioned capability on protocol 2; package version to be agreed
extensionProposals.operations: Propose execution_prepare, execution_consume, execution_settle, execution_reconcile; none is shipped.
extensionProposals.localConsumer: EndpointPort.preparedExecution, PreparedExecutionPort.version=1, extends the existing HostAuthority lifetime. admit receives the unchanged AdmissionRequest plus a cloned ManagedIdentityRecord and socket connection generation. Match registered actor/installation, exact snapshot digest, policy revision, trust/registration generation and original producer lease before returning admission; recheck at the sink. No production producer or capability advertisement is installed.
extensionProposals.lifetime: The negotiated producer must durably consume once, pin native executable/resource identities and descendant ownership, revoke on policy/registration/trust/disconnect, and settle/reconcile through its original lease. Local cancellation invalidates pending admission, duplicate attempts are refused, and thrown/lost outcomes remain unknown even after disconnect. In-memory retry fences do not replace producer durable reconciliation after restart.
extensionProposals.publishedSchemas: executionBinding describes trusted resolved handles; executionConsumption is already consumed with unknown outcome; executionCompletion is settlement evidence. None grants a new local effect. Missing transport negotiation and prepare/consume/settle/reconcile mapping remain proposed-not-negotiated.
extensionProposals.missing: Prepare binds registration/delegation/workflow, request/attempt/run, exact argv/env/cwd/resources and digests, provider/model/route/credential, policy/DLP/budget/egress/backend. Return single-use expiring grant/handle and bindingDigest; consume/settle/reconcile preserve durable unknown outcomes and process/descendant ownership.

extensionProposals.version: new versioned capability on protocol 2; package version to be agreed
extensionProposals.operations: Propose effect_authorize, effect_settle, effect_reconcile; none is shipped.
extensionProposals.missing: Exact command/file/permission/tool input plus leaseId, authenticated actor reference, provider/thread/turn/request IDs, effect digest, policy revision, expiry, revocation and idempotency. Correlated allow/deny/unavailable/unknown must remain distinct; a launch/dispatch receipt cannot grant an effect.
extensionProposals.localConsumer: ManagedEffectProducer.version=1 is injected through ManagedHostAdapterDeps.effectProducer only after authenticated negotiation. createManagedEffectAuthority sends a cloned full request plus binding, digest, policy revision and standing generation to authorize, validates its receipt, then consumes once before returning a live-checked allow. No production producer, endpoint operation or advertised capability is installed.
extensionProposals.lifetime: Only an owned bound prepared lease with matching actor/provider and current registration/policy/trust may ask. Lease release/revocation and caller cancellation abort pending requests. Inputs, receipt identity/digest/policy/expiry and standing are rechecked after each await and at the reply sink, including after relay consent. Lost/malformed responses stay unknown; retries and reused receipts are held. In-memory fences do not replace durable producer reconciliation.
extensionProposals.nativeBoundary: The negotiated producer must pin exact native file/executable/network identities, enforce confinement and descendant revocation through the actual effect, and durably settle/reconcile consumption. Receipt consume grants one permission without executing the effect. These obligations are not implemented by the published wire schemas and remain unqualified. Complete provider inputs are preserved; a permission projection alone cannot qualify native confinement.

extensionProposals.version: local delivery extension for desktop-policy schema 1
extensionProposals.operations: Propose desktop_policy, offline_choices and typed ceiling delivery; no corresponding local endpoint operations are published.
extensionProposals.localConsumer: MCOMP-15-01 extends createPolicyStatusService with NativePolicyProjectionPort.version=1, a trusted host-only readVerified port plus the pinned DesktopPolicySchemaPort. The producer must authenticate negotiation and verify signatures over the entire desktop/settings/routes/secondary-ceilings batch against protected identity, registration and trust root before returning. No production producer, wire operation or capability advertisement is installed.
extensionProposals.installation: The consumer reuses desktop-policy schema 1, ManagedRouteCeiling, parseManagedSettingsPolicy and nine existing ceiling parsers. It validates tenant/org/enrollment/installation/actor/runtime/epoch, applied revision, freshness, complete sections and route shape before one atomic in-memory replacement. Connection/trust/registration/source changes and superseded requests are rejected. Same-revision content conflicts, rollback and older projections retain the previous restrictions. Reads return copies scoped to identity/actor/trust; disconnected or expired policy never grants execution, and restart defaults to unavailable until verified refresh. Settings/choice/effect sink composition remains in the dependent implementation tasks.
extensionProposals.missing: Authenticated registration/policy digest and revision, projection freshness, approved provider/model/account/workspace/tool/credential references, and explicit browser/shell/plugin/install/egress/listener/custody constraints. Published UI projection alone cannot authorize host mutations or effects.
extensionProposals.approvedOptions: MCOMP-15-03 returns only bounded opaque desktop references with locks, revision and an expiry bounded by projection, registration and observation freshness. Optional host-only executionChoices binds providerRef to explicit permission modes and opaque transport references, limited to 128 providers and 128 transports each. The whole extension must be signed in the native batch. Missing executionChoices yields unavailable fields, never unrestricted options. Current port, actor/trust/runtime/epoch, connection and applied revision are rechecked on every read. Commit/run must revalidate independently; no producer or wire capability is supplied.

extensionProposals.version: local delivery extension for content schema 1
extensionProposals.operations: Propose content_capture, content_upload_status and content_revoke at the endpoint; central HTTP upload definitions already exist.
extensionProposals.missing: Signed role/representation/sensitivity permissions, registration/run/policy binding, bounded chunk digest and residency, upload reference, durable acceptance, deletion/revocation and lost-response status. Pending bytes never imply uploaded evidence.

extensionProposals.version: local delivery extension for deviceInboxRecovery schema 1
extensionProposals.operations: Propose inbox_recover over the local endpoint; central deviceInboxRecoveryInput/Result already exist.
extensionProposals.missing: Registration-bound campaign/message/idempotency/requestDigest lookup and receipt custody; missing/unbound returns unavailable. No actor selector or automatic replay of private replies.

extensionProposals.version: protected independent headless identity custody extension; protocol/package version to be agreed
extensionProposals.operations: No public local operation delegates protected identity custody to a Node host. Propose an authenticated endpoint-owned host identity/custody binding; no speculative operation is sent.
extensionProposals.missing: Bind installation/runtime/process epoch and verified OS peer to an independently protected enrollment, freshness/rollback anchor, revocation and authenticated release. Never export Electron safeStorage keys, copy bearer credentials, or interpret schema imports as native support. Maestro uses the existing SealProvider/AnchorStore and EndpointPort when protected custody is supplied; default Node remains unavailable.

localTestBoundary.inputs: Required verified extracted contracts and exact Zod dependency; absence/tampering fails before schema loading.
localTestBoundary.cases: Public exports/ports/tasks, unsupported version/operation, forged actor/fleet purpose, actual transport replay, expired registration with fresh policy, endpoint denials, lost execution response with no retry, receipt versus permit, absent effect authority; existing public facade conformance remains exercised.
localTestBoundary.limits: Endpoint is a declared local double; denial parsing is not policy enforcement. No provider process, signed production policy, live actor authentication or paired/native security receipt. MCOMP-13-01 removes the broker-receipt-to-local-lease path. Prepared local tests inject an explicit authority; production prepared/per-effect wire mapping and all paired/native proof remain pending.
